title: Freight Handling Rates by Merchandise Class for Northgate Purchases & Returns Business Route Pickups
content:
Handling table for the route pickup fee that Northgate Purchases & Returns invoices on the changed-mind freight pickup of special-order merchandise for a Northgate Business Membership or Northgate Business Plus Membership.

## Route pickup piece handling rate

When the sale line on the authorization is in merchandise class major appliance, each unit after the first is handled at 18.00; when it is in class mattress and furniture, each unit after the first is handled at 12.00; otherwise each unit after the first is handled at 10.00.

| Merchandise class of the sale line on the authorization | Handling per unit after the first |
|---|---|
| major appliance | 18.00 |
| mattress and furniture | 12.00 |
| any other class | 10.00 |

The class is the merchandise class recorded on the sale line that the authorization covers; the units are the units on the authorization, and the first unit carries no handling.

## Worked handling (hypothetical authorizations)

| Authorization | Units after the first | Rate | Piece handling |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 refrigerators (major appliance) | 3 | 18.00 | 54.00 |
| 3 sofas (mattress and furniture) | 2 | 12.00 | 24.00 |
| 6 televisions | 5 | 10.00 | 50.00 |
| 1 washer (major appliance) | 0 | 18.00 | 0.00 |
